data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002's mechanism claims 'neither architecture can withstand the loss of a shared external dependency,' but its second countercondition posits that 'The large service's internal redundancy includes independent replicas of all external dependencies, achieving strict isolation.' If the large service replicates all external dependencies internally (e.g., running its own DNS, certificate authority, etc.), it CAN withstand the loss of external shared dependencies that would cascade through the decentralized network. By flatly asserting 'neither architecture can withstand the loss of a shared external dependency,' SRC_002 contradicts its own countercondition and fails to address how the two architectures compare when the large service strictly isolates itself from external dependencies.
